closing.exact-slope-cap.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.gradient_abs_le_on: The proof bounds `gradient` using the spatial Lipschitz constant $1$ of `value`, for every $x$ and $t\le1$. Squaring and averaging along $X_t$ gives $q(t)\le1$, the exact cap violated by the proposed polynomial.

scalar.manuscript_terminal_value#1.OAI.SKValue.scalar_value_target: `ScalarValueConclusion` gives a terminal witness `U` for the scalar-model slope and equates $P_*$ to its expectation paired with $B_1$. The almost-sure and mean-square limits identify the same witness.

scalar.formal_scalar_clause#1.OAI.SKValue.ScalarValueConclusion: The equality containing `curvature` expresses `groundStateValue` as $\int_0^1\mathbb E[a(t,X_t)]\,dt$, with no square on $a$. The final clause requires interval integrability of this first-moment function.

closing.second-curvature-moment.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.FullSupportConclus: For every `X` satisfying `IsDiffusion` and every `t : Time`, the last equality squares `curvature` inside the integral to give $\mathbb E[a(t,X_t)^2]=1$. The preceding `squareMoment` equality squares the slope and gives $\mathbb E[u(t,X_t)^2]=t$.

lean.full_support#1.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.full_support: The last three parts of `FullSupportConclusion` give support, strict increase and the moment equalities. The moment equalities are stated for any associated diffusion, and the proof uses uniqueness to derive them from the constructed one.
lean.full_support#1.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.FullSupportConclus: The support equality is required for every Stieltjes measure of $\gamma$, and `Set.univ` here means the relative time space $[0,1)$. Alongside strict increase of $\gamma$, the final clause requires $\mathbb E[u(t,X_t)^2]=t$ and $\mathbb E[a(t,X_t)^2]=1$ for every diffusion and every $0\le t<1$.

assumptions.full_support_minimizer#6.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.full_support: `hmin` is an input to `full_support`. The conclusion supplies a Stieltjes measure and an associated diffusion after the caller has provided the minimiser.
assumptions.full_support_minimizer#6.OAI.ZeroTemperatureSK.IsMinimizer: The quantifier in `IsMinimizer` compares the supplied parameter with every `OrderParameter` on the same Brownian system. The weak inequality allows ties in the Parisi value.

scalar.lean_scalar_target#2.OAI.SKValue.scalar_value_target: In `ScalarValueConclusion` the two value clauses equate `groundStateValue` with the terminal Brownian pairing and the time integral of expected curvature. The minimiser and diffusion come from the scalar model.
scalar.lean_scalar_target#2.OAI.SKValue.ScalarValueConclusion: The equalities identify `groundStateValue` with $\mathbb E|X_1|-\int_0^1t\gamma(t)\,dt$, with $\mathbb E[U B_1]$, and with $\int_0^1\mathbb E[a(t,X_t)]\,dt$. The existentially quantified $U$ extends the slope to the martingale `gradientStopped` and is its limit almost surely and in mean square as $t\uparrow1$.

scalar.lean_gaussian_target#2.OAI.SKValue.finite_gaussian_target: `FiniteGaussianConclusion` first gives convergence of the shifted Gaussian coefficient sum as the mesh is refined at fixed $T<1$. The later cutoff limit of its curvature integral gives the full value.
scalar.lean_gaussian_target#2.OAI.SKValue.FiniteGaussianConclusion: The first clause makes `normalizer` positive for all active indices $j<N$ once the mesh is fine enough. The next two clauses prescribe the mesh limit of `shiftedCoefficientSum` at fixed cutoff, then the left limit of the curvature integral at one.
